risk_profile_meta.why_cash_band_ko: 균형형에서 흔히 쓰는 중간 현금 완충(약 10–25%)에 맞춘 정책 구간입니다.
risk_profile_meta.why_cash_band_en: Policy band aligned with the mid cash cushion (~10–25%) common for balanced retail styles.
risk_profile_meta.cash_footnote_ko: 현금 10–25%는 균형형 소매 투자 성향에 맞춘 제품 휴리스틱입니다. Kelly·CAPM·단일 논문의 최적 현금이 아닙니다. 10일 VaR 예산도 같은 성향 정책입니다. HRP 제안 현금이 밴드를 넘을 수 있습니다 — 밴드는 성향 목표, HRP는 위험 평탄화 제안입니다.
risk_profile_meta.cash_footnote_en: The 10–25% cash band is a product heuristic for a balanced retail style — not Kelly, CAPM, or a single-paper optimum. The VaR budget is the same policy. HRP cash can exceed the band: the band is the style target; HRP is a risk-flattening proposal.
risk_profile_meta.methodology_note_ko: 현금 min/max와 10일 VaR 예산은 소매 투자 성향(보수·균형·공격)에 맞춘 제품 정책 휴리스틱입니다. Kelly 공식·CAPM·단일 학술 논문에서 유도한 최적 현금 비중이 아닙니다. HRP 조절 제안의 현금 비중이 밴드를 넘을 수 있습니다 — 밴드는 성향 목표, HRP는 위험 평탄화 제안입니다.
risk_profile_meta.methodology_note_en: Cash min/max and 10-day VaR budgets are product policy heuristics for retail risk styles (conservative / balanced / aggressive). They are not an optimal-cash formula from Kelly, CAPM, or a single paper. HRP cash suggestions can exceed the band — the band is the style target; HRP is a risk-flattening proposal.

profile.blurb_en: A typical mix of growth and defense for a middle-of-the-road investor.
profile.why_cash_band_en: Policy band aligned with the mid cash cushion (~10–25%) common for balanced retail styles.
profile.cash_footnote_en: The 10–25% cash band is a product heuristic for a balanced retail style — not Kelly, CAPM, or a single-paper optimum. The VaR budget is the same policy. HRP cash can exceed the band: the band is the style target; HRP is a risk-flattening proposal.

how_to_read_en: Risk contribution (%) = who actually shakes the account (can differ from weight)
Sharpe & return = past scorecard · VaR & volatility = how painful it can get
‘Suggested moves’ below are about spreading risk more evenly — not a jackpot forecast
No target return is used; expected-return guesses go wrong easily

metric_cards.plain_en: A thermometer for how much the portfolio might wobble — roughly ±15.6% over a year in either direction. Bigger number, more stomach-churn.
metric_cards.analogy_en: Closer to ‘how rough is the road?’ than to how fast the car is going.

metric_cards.plain_en: How much you earned above a cash-like rate, divided by how hard it bounced. Near 1 is often called decent — but a run of strong assets can inflate it. Not a promise about the future.
metric_cards.analogy_en: A scorecard for reward per unit of motion sickness (risk).

metric_cards.title_en: How sore it could get (10-day VaR 95%)
metric_cards.plain_en: If markets behave a bit like recently, a loss of this size over about two weeks is in the ‘bad but not unheard-of’ bucket. It does not mean you will lose exactly this much tomorrow.
metric_cards.analogy_en: Like an insurance deductible — ‘could you live with a hit this big?’

metric_cards.plain_en: Cumulative return over roughly the past year of trading days, counted backward from today — not a calendar year (Jan 1–Dec 31).
metric_cards.analogy_en: Last semester’s grade — not next semester’s forecast.

ui_copy_en.risk_contribution_plain_en: What shakes the account most right now is '하이닉스 2배 ETF(현물×2 프록시)' (risk contribution 52.1%).
clusters_plain_en: The 'Tech / growth cluster' group (달러 현금(환율 위험), 엔비디아, 러셀2000(IWM), 테슬라, 인베스코 QQQ) tends to move together, so despite several tickers it can act like one lump of risk (combined weight about 47.6%).
ui_copy_en.currency_plain_en: About 28.6% is tied directly to the won; about 71.4% sits in dollar / FX-exposed assets. Even ‘safe’ USD cash still moves with the exchange rate.
stress_plain_en: Tightening / inflation stretch (2022): holding today’s weights through that window would have been about -13.9% (illustrative — ignores trades you made then)
Last 90 trading days: holding today’s weights through that window would have been about 8.9% (illustrative — ignores trades you made then)
profile_breaches_en: 10-day VaR 5.1% is above your profile budget of 5.0% (swings look large vs. your risk style).

moves_up_en.plain_en: To pile less risk in one place, leaning relatively more into '달러 현금(환율 위험)' is the direction (+2.6%p).
To pile less risk in one place, leaning relatively more into '일본국채 ETF(1482.T 프록시)' is the direction (+2.6%p).

moves_down_en.plain_en: Swings are concentrated here — trimming '엔비디아' helps diversification (-7.3%p).
Swings are concentrated here — trimming '하이닉스 2배 ETF(현물×2 프록시)' helps diversification (-3.0%p).

ui_copy_en.footer_en: Numbers here are a calculator on past prices — not buy/sell orders. The point is less like a broker order ticket and more like seeing where risk has piled up.
ui_copy_en.rebalance_note_en: Moving weights costs fees, taxes, and FX spreads — so trimming the biggest concentrations first usually beats chasing every suggested percent in one go.

metric_cards.plain_ko: 최근과 비슷한 장세라면, 앞으로 약 2주(10거래일) 동안 나쁜 경우(대략 20번에 1번 꼴, 95% 기준)에 이 정도까지 손실이 날 수 있다고 보는 완충 규모입니다. 내일 꼭 이만큼 잃는다는 뜻은 아닙니다.
metric_cards.analogy_ko: ‘이 정도 손실까지는 감수할 준비가 됐는지’를 점검하는 참고액입니다.

metric_cards.plain_ko: 과거 구간에 감수했던 흔들림 대비 얼마나 효율적으로 수익을 냈는지입니다. 1 근처면 괜찮은 편으로 보는 경우가 많지만, 최근에 잘 간 자산에 실리면 자연히 높아질 수 있습니다. 미래 보장은 아닙니다.
metric_cards.analogy_ko: 같은 위험을 감수했을 때 과거 수익이 얼마나 효율적이었는지 비교하는 점수입니다.

metric_cards.plain_ko: 현재 현금·대기자금 비중은 23.8%입니다. 선택하신 '일반 (균형)' 성향의 권장 구간은 10.0%~25.0%입니다. 위험 균등(HRP) 모형이 현금을 크게 늘리라고 해도, 성향 밴드를 공식 목표로 두고 그 안에서 맞추는 것이 맞습니다.
metric_cards.analogy_ko: 비상금·대기자금처럼, 흔들릴 때 버틸 여유를 남겨 두는 비중입니다.

metric_cards.plain_ko: 오늘 기준으로 거슬러 약 1년(거래일) 동안의 누적 수익률입니다. 달력 연도(1월~12월)가 아니라, ‘지금 시점에서 본 지난 1년’입니다.
metric_cards.analogy_ko: 이미 지나간 성적이지, 앞으로의 예상이 아닙니다.

ui_copy_basic_ko.risk_contribution_plain_ko: 지금 계좌를 가장 크게 흔드는 것은 '하이닉스 2배 ETF(현물×2 프록시)'입니다 (집중도 52.1%).
clusters_plain_ko: ‘기술·성장 묶음'(달러 현금(환율 위험), 엔비디아, 러셀2000(IWM), 테슬라, 인베스코 QQQ)이 함께 움직이는 편이라, 종목 수와 달리 사실상 한 덩어리 위험(합 비중 약 47.6%)일 수 있습니다.
ui_copy_basic_ko.currency_plain_ko: 원화에 직접 묶인 비중 약 28.6%, 달러·환산 자산 등 외화 쪽 약 71.4%입니다. 달러 현금도 안전자산처럼 보여도, 환율만큼은 흔들립니다.
stress_plain_ko: 긴축·인플레 구간 (2022): 그 구간에 지금 비중을 유지했다고 가정하면 약 -13.9% (참고용 · 당시 매매는 반영하지 않음)
최근 90거래일: 그 구간에 지금 비중을 유지했다고 가정하면 약 8.9% (참고용 · 당시 매매는 반영하지 않음)
profile_breaches_ko: 10일 VaR 5.1%가 성향 한도 5.0%을 넘습니다 (성향 대비 손실·변동 규모가 큽니다).

moves_up_ko.plain_ko: 흔들림이 한곳에 몰리는 걸 줄이려면 '달러 현금(환율 위험)' 비중을 상대적으로 키우는 방향입니다 (+2.6%p).

ui_copy_basic_ko.glossary_note_ko: VaR·Sharpe 등 상세 지표는 expert 모드에서 확인하세요.
ui_copy_basic_ko.footer_ko: 이 화면의 숫자는 과거 가격으로 돌린 계산 결과입니다. 매수·매도 지시가 아니며, ‘위험이 어디에 몰렸는지’와 성향에 맞는 현금 여유를 보는 데 초점이 있습니다.
ui_copy_basic_ko.rebalance_note_ko: 비중을 옮길 때는 수수료·세금·환전 비용이 있으니, 제안 %를 한 번에 맞추기보다 큰 쏠림과 현금 밴드부터 맞추는 편이 실무적입니다.

ui_copy_basic_en.headline_en: Your selected risk style is 'Balanced'. Right now, about 52% of account swings come from '하이닉스 2배 ETF(현물×2 프록시)'; some items sit outside your style limits. Practical next step: trim the assets that shake the account most. (Style cash band 10.0%–25.0% is the official target — even if the model suggests a much larger cash sleeve.)

profile.blurb_en: A typical mix of growth and defense for a middle-of-the-road investor.

how_to_read_en: Account-swing concentration = who actually shakes the account (can differ from weight)
Expected swing range & near-term loss cushion = how bumpy / how sore · efficiency & 1Y return = past scorecard
‘Suggested weight moves’ below spread risk more evenly — not a return forecast
Cash & reserves: use the style band (10.0%–25.0%) as the target, not extreme model cash
No target return is used; expected-return guesses go wrong easily

metric_cards.plain_en: A yearly reference for how far the portfolio might move — roughly ±15.6% in either direction. Larger number means bigger swings.
metric_cards.analogy_en: A gauge for how much the account balance can bounce around.

metric_cards.plain_en: If markets behave a bit like recently, over about two weeks (10 trading days) a bad case (roughly 1-in-20, 95% convention) can look this large. It does not mean you will lose exactly this much tomorrow.
metric_cards.analogy_en: A cushion check — ‘could you live with a hit this big?’

metric_cards.plain_en: How efficiently past returns compensated for the swings you took. Near 1 is often called decent — but a run of strong assets can inflate it. Not a promise about the future.
metric_cards.analogy_en: A historical scorecard for reward relative to how rough the ride was.

metric_cards.plain_en: Cash / reserve weight is 23.8% now. For your 'Balanced' style the recommended band is 10.0%–25.0%. Even if the risk-parity model pushes cash much higher, treat the style band as the official target and stay inside it.
metric_cards.analogy_en: Like an emergency / standby fund — room to absorb bad weeks.

metric_cards.plain_en: Cumulative return over roughly the past year of trading days, counted backward from today — not a calendar year (Jan 1–Dec 31).
metric_cards.analogy_en: Last semester’s grade — not next semester’s forecast.

profile_breaches_en: 10-day VaR 5.1% is above your profile budget of 5.0% (swings look large vs. your risk style).

ui_copy_basic_en.glossary_note_en: Detailed metrics such as VaR and Sharpe are in expert mode.
ui_copy_basic_en.footer_en: Numbers here are a calculator on past prices — not buy/sell orders. The focus is where risk has piled up and whether cash reserves fit your style.
ui_copy_basic_en.rebalance_note_en: Moving weights costs fees, taxes, and FX spreads — so fixing cash-band gaps and the biggest concentrations usually beats chasing every suggested percent.
